name: proyecto-fiavl
description: Plataforma de microservicios para el Festival Internacional de Artes Vivas Loja

scripts.instalar: npm install && npm install --prefix services/api-gateway && npm install --prefix services/programacion-service && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,programacion,frontend -c blue,magenta,green "npm start --prefix services/api-gateway" "npm start --prefix services/programacion-service" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
